facts.text: I volunteered at the Brooklyn Film Festival last week.
I helped with ticketing at the Brooklyn Film Festival.
I helped with crowd control at the Brooklyn Film Festival.
I volunteered for the documentary feature "The Cave" at the Brooklyn Film Festival.
I met the director of "The Cave", Feras Fayyad, during the Brooklyn Film Festival.
I attended a panel discussion on "Women in Film" during the Brooklyn Film Festival.
I got to attend a panel discussion featuring several prominent female directors and producers.
I attended a Q&A session with Wes Anderson after the screening of "The French Dispatch" at the New York Film Festival.
I am interested in learning more about non-linear editing.
I am interested in non-linear editing in films like "Memento" and "Pulp Fiction".
I am planning to attend a film editing workshop next weekend.

keyphrases: basic software and hardware for film editing
